reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_raw,
       CASE WHEN c.parent_category = 'TV & Video' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS in_parent
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_raw,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.category_id = p.category_id AND c.parent_category = 'TV & Video')
            THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS in_parent
FROM products p
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_raw, CASE WHEN c.parent_category IS NOT NULL AND c.parent_category = 'TV & Video' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS in_parent FROM products p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE TRIM(LOWER(p.category_raw)) IN ('tv & video', 'tv en video', 'tv/video', 'téléviseurs')

       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.category_id = p.category_id AND c.parent_category = 'TV & Video')
            THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS in_parent
FROM products p
